visualCharacteristics: Uniform responsive grid of square recipe tiles. Each tile is a linked photo with the recipe name and a 'View Recipe' CTA overlaid on a dark gradient at the bottom.
contentPattern: One row per recipe. First cell holds the recipe thumbnail image; the body cell holds the recipe name (heading) and a 'View Recipe' link. The whole card is clickable.
usage: Used for the recipe grid on the 7up recipes page (~25 tiles).
